# SEC ownership fixtures

Hand-written in the column and tag layout of the SEC Insider Transactions Data Sets readme, the
Form 13F Data Sets readme, the Form 4 `ownershipDocument` schema and the Form 144 XML. Issuers,
owners, CIKs and CUSIPs are fictitious. sec.gov does not resolve from the cloud sandbox, so no
recorded download exists yet; replace with a trimmed real quarter on the local machine and keep
these as the minimal cases (Q-050).
